reason: User architecture decision on 2026-09-10: Prose is complete and retired. There is no remaining Prose work. Any remaining integration of the completed Prose capability belongs to the parent Book System. Documents is not the Prose integration target.
preservation_rules: All historical Prose branches, exact SHAs, A-01/hosted receipts, blind/private/author boundaries, census records and completion evidence remain immutable provenance.
Retirement never transfers PASS from a historical Prose subject to changed Book integration bytes.
No new active PROSE owner obligation, Second Shift delegation, repair transaction, research task, qualification task, chat role, telemetry lane or scheduled worker may be created.
Any still-required integration work is represented only as BOOK-owned integration work; it must not be represented as continuing Prose development.
Documents remains a separate peer system for generic document/artifact capabilities and receives no Prose ownership or successor work.

retired_second_shift.book_integration_rule: If integration remains incomplete, it is ordinary BOOK-owned work in the BOOK lane, not successor PROSE work.

terminal_rule: PROSE remains terminally complete after Book integration. Completing Book integration must not create another Prose successor.
